analysis: The PR modifies only docs/developer/test.md. Per the file_changes patch, the edits (a) drop "retained-console" from the intro line, (b) reword the paragraph at base lines 958-962 so it says darkbloom-platform keeps byte-identical copies of paged_footprint_wire.json and process_memory_wire.json for its own coordinator and console tests, and (c) drop "console packaging" from the docs-impact mapping sentence at base ~1071-1072. The patch excerpt is truncated and the base lines 1084-1097 range (the Retained Console section) is listed as changed, so the removal of that section is inferred from the range map and not visible in the patch text. No source code, protocol, cryptographic, authorization, attestation, cache, or key-handling behavior is changed. The supplied text for the other threat-relevant areas (T-041 prefix-cache test guidance, add-on hold tests for TB-012/T-059/T-060, App Attest dispatch tests, and logout/resumption tests) is unchanged context and contains no new security claim. The only things to confirm are (1) that the fixture byte-identity remains enforced elsewhere and (2) that the retained-console content is genuinely moved to the platform repo, but these are documentation and ownership matters, not security regressions. The threat model remains consistent: the backend and console are out of scope. No findings. I did not see the rest of the patch beyond the excerpt, so I treat the console-section removal as a docs change only.
